news_analysis.headline_hook: 1 Lakh-ku 25 bps hike-na kidaikkum extra amount-a கணக்கு பண்ணுங்க!
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: The Reserve Bank of India increased the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50%, creating expectations that commercial banks will raise fixed deposit interest rates by 5 to 25 basis points.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Depositors often assume a central bank rate hike automatically and immediately increases yields on their existing fixed deposits across all tenures.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Existing fixed deposits remain locked at their agreed contract rates, and banks selectively adjust deposit rates on specific tenures based on their own liquidity needs rather than passing on hikes uniformly.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Check your bank's revised card rates across specific tenures before opening new deposits, and verify whether premature renewal penalties negate the benefit of higher rates on existing funds.
news_analysis.editorial_directive: Use conversational Tanglish. Keep sentences short. Always anchor the 'bps' hike to a specific rupee amount (e.g., 1 Lakh) so the reader feels the direct impact on their pocket. Avoid jargon; use simple terms like 'extra earnings' or 'interest jump'.

stat_data.label: New Repo Rate
stat_data.context: Repo rate 5.25% la irundhu 5.5% ku uyarthirukanga. Idhu banks-kitta irundhu varum FD interest rates-a increase panna encourage pannum.

comparison_data.myth: Repo rate hike pannudhu na, udane enoda existing FD interest rate-um eridum.
comparison_data.reality: Illa! Existing FD-la neenga sign panna contract rate-dhan maturity varaikkum kidaikkum.

stat_data.label: Deposit Amount
stat_data.context: 25 bps hike-na, 1 Lakh deposit-ku interest-la chinna jump kidaikkum. Adhe 10 Lakh deposit-na, indha extra earnings innum adhigama irukkum.

slides.title: Bank-oda strategy
slides.card_text: Ellaa banks-um ellaa tenure-kum rate-a hike pannuvangala? Illa. Banks avangaloda liquidity needs-ku etha maari select-aana tenure-ku mattume rate-a mathuvanga.

checklist_data.text: Tenure wise interest rate difference-a paarunga.
Premature withdrawal penalty irukka nu confirm pannunga.

slides.title: Penalty trap-a thaviringa
slides.card_text: Pudhu FD-la kidaikkum extra interest-a paathu, pazhaya FD-a break panna nenaikadheenga. Penalty-la unga profit poirum!

slides.title: Actionable Tip
slides.cta_detail: Next time FD podum bodhu, bank website-la 'Revised Card Rates' page-a check panni, unga tenure-ku best rate kidaikkudha nu confirm pannitu invest pannunga. Indha info useful-a irundha save pannikonga!
